from donations import feed_donations, ROWS
from splits import split_window


def test_second_half():
    first, second = split_window(feed_donations(), 4)
    assert second == [v for _, v in ROWS[2:4]]


def test_reads_only_the_window():
    feed = feed_donations()
    split_window(feed, 2)
    assert next(feed).pounds == ROWS[2][1]
